title: Celero, which is developing a chip to enable long-distance connections between AI data centers, raised $275M at a $3B+ valuation (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
summary: Dina Bass / Bloomberg: Celero, which is developing a chip to enable long-distance connections between AI data centers, raised $275M at a $3B+ valuation — Celero Communications, a maker of networking chips, has raised $275 million in a funding round that values the startup at more than $3 billion …
